name: Bass Burp
description: Lower still, with a little drive into the ladder: a bass line that burps on every note.

name: Clav Snap
description: Higher and tighter, half the dry signal under it: a clav's snap made bigger.

name: Funk Quack
description: Low and resonant, opened fast by each pick: the quack of a seventies rhythm guitar.

name: Singing Ladder
description: The resonance near singing and the amount full: a squelch that follows every note's loudness.

name: Slow Bloom
description: The slow follower: each chord swells open and lingers, for an electric piano or a pad.
